notes.title: HotFix (1.02)
notes.notes:
-Fixed Leaderboard (scores should now be uploaded properly to the leaderboard upon completion)

-Slight Fix to the smoothing of the Jungle Parallax pulldown. This should hopefuly reduce some of the motion sickeness players were experiencing.

-Fixed "Fall Distance" achievements being accumulative distance fell. Players should only get the achievements when they truly fall the requisite distance.

-Added SFX to the minecart and minecart explosions

-Added a forced push off of "Thorn" objects when the player is colliding with them for an extended period of time. (This should fix softlocks on the top of some of the "Thorn Covered Woodpanels")

-Fixed the timer not rolling over into hours properly. Time should now be displayed in (hours : minutes : seconds.)

-Replaced "Lennard The Squirrel's" flavor dialogue with better instructions on how to do the "Arc Grapple" mechanic.

-Added some extra stone blocks exiting the jungle biome.

-Removed a rogue collider in the canopy section

Thank you so much to everyone who has been playing Pudding Frog! It means the world to me to see people enjoying and or hating the game. Good luck on your adventure, and I look forward to seeing some of your times on the leaderboard!

The leaderboard can be found in CommunityHub ->View Stats -> Global Leaderboard
